summary: Claude Code edited PAGE_SIZE 10→25 in list.js directly on the single request, with no brainstorming skill and no permission-seeking question. One internal interlock error caused a retry of the Edit tool, invisible as a question to the user.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria are satisfied per screen output and the session log: the value change landed on disk with no brainstorming skill load and no approval question posed to me.

observations.description: The first Edit tool call returned a long red 'Error: Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap...' block that is rendered to the user as an error. It is internal machinery, but a developer watching the screen sees a scary multi-line red error before the successful edit; the edit then succeeded on retry.
Interlock message text is dense and instruction-like ('Dispatched subagents: if rung 1 applies...') and leaks internal process language into the user-visible transcript.
Agent ran a Bash call and a directory listing ('Read 1 file, listed 1 directory') before the edit — minor extra work for a one-line change, but not a blocking issue.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ⎿ Added 1 line, removed 1 line  1 - const PAGE_SIZE = 10;  1 + const PAGE_SIZE = 25;" and final text "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. No other changes."; disk: `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE coding-agent-workdir/list.js` → "list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". Worked for 18s, no follow-up prompts to me.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming invocation, no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence was only Bash, Read, Edit, Edit (jq over 35dc34fb-*.jsonl: {"type":"assistant","c":["tool_use:Bash"]} ... tool_use:Read, tool_use:Edit, tool_use:Edit). `grep -o '"name":"Skill"' *.jsonl` returned 2 hits, both inside bootstrap/system prompt text (context shows '...brainstorming skill first; plan mode is design work...'), not tool calls. The agent asked me nothing at all; its only assistant text was the completion line.
